SourceTerm: 乾坤之內，宇宙之間，中有一寶，祕在形山

Senses.PreferredTarget: within the compass of heaven and earth, one treasure hidden in the shape-mountain

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB494.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Yushan. Yushan Shangsi owns the retained deployment: in an address to the assembly sets the treasure within the compass of heaven and earth, hidden in the shape-mountain, that the buddhas of the three times dare not eye and the patriarchs of the ages dare not handle, then announces that Qingyun today will break the taboo and disclose the hiding, specially lifting it out to them all.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1318.xml). Continued Essentials from the Sayings of Ancient Worthies. Baoning Renyong owns the retained deployment: on his journey sets the four lines and asks what treasure this is, not blue yellow red or white, not man or woman in mark, no saying what it is, ruled that measured upward it falls short and measured downward there is more than enough, then lifting his staff calls it the thing Yunmen, Linji, Deshan and Yantou could never use up in a lifetime, now in Baoning's hand not worth half a cash and yet both dear and cheap, asking where the dear and the cheap lie, and dashing down the staff.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1367.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xiaoyin Daxin. Xiaoyin Daxin owns the retained deployment: at the year's-end assembly raises Yunmen's address, the treasure hidden in the shape-mountain, the lantern lifted to the buddha hall and the gate set on the lantern, then rules it big beyond outside and small beyond inside, choking the ravines and filling the ditches, mud-balls and clods of earth, riding the buddha hall backwards out the mountain gate, while the dew-pillars and the lantern understand nothing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 急如箭，黑似漆，無言童子口吧吧，無足仙人劈𮌎踢。良久，云：交。師云：五祖老人與麼說話，也是靈龜曳尾。者十件事有甚麼難數？前年底、去年底、今年底，牛頭南、馬頭北，和底盡掀翻，從來沒蹤跡。二由一有，一亦莫守，前三後三，烏飛兔走。今朝天氣嚴寒，不出頭是好手，暖處商量也未然，須知不在口皮邊。展兩手，云：了。上堂。乾坤之內，宇宙之間，中有一寶，祕在形山。眼󳬇不到時，填溝塞壑；言思不及處，天寬地寬。卓主丈，云：剛被賣油翁發笑，忙者自忙閑者閑。下座。佛涅槃，上堂：涅槃無自性，自性無涅槃。諸佛無涅槃，亦無涅槃佛。五臺山上雲蒸飯，佛殿階前狗尿天。剎竿頭上煎䭔子，三箇胡孫夜簸錢。上堂：古人道：明知只是者箇，只是用不着。山僧道：明知只是者箇，入地獄如箭射。牛角長
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1412.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Gulin Qingmao. Gulin Qingmao owns the retained deployment: opens the hall with the four lines, the treasure within the compass of heaven and earth hidden in the shape-mountain, then marks its double hiding, where the eye does not reach ditches and hollows are filled, and where words and thought do not reach sky is wide and earth is wide, striking the staff, the oil-seller laughs, the busy busy and the idle idle.

Senses.Explanation: Yunmen Wenyan's four-liner on the one treasure hidden in the hill of form, and the masters who broke the taboo on it. Yunmen Wenyan addresses the assembly with the four lines, within the compass of heaven and earth, between the reaches of the cosmos, one treasure hidden in the shape-mountain, then shows the hiding place at once, lifting the lantern toward the buddha hall and setting the mountain gate on the lantern, Yushan Shangsi in an address to the assembly sets the treasure that the buddhas of the three times dare not eye and the patriarchs of the ages dare not handle, then announces that Qingyun today will break the taboo and disclose the hiding, specially lifting it out to them all, and Baoning Renyong on his journey asks what treasure this is, not blue yellow red or white, no saying what it is, ruled that measured upward it falls short and measured downward there is more than enough, then lifting his staff calls it the thing Yunmen, Linji, Deshan and Yantou could never use up in a lifetime, now in Baoning's hand not worth half a cash and yet both dear and cheap, asking where the dear and the cheap lie. Xiaoyin Daxin at the year's-end assembly raises Yunmen's address, the treasure hidden in the shape-mountain with the lantern lifted to the buddha hall and the gate set on the lantern, then rules it big beyond outside and small beyond inside, choking the ravines and filling the ditches, mud-balls and clods of earth, riding the buddha hall backwards out the mountain gate while the dew-pillars and the lantern understand nothing, and Gulin Qingmao opens the hall with the four lines and marks the double hiding, where the eye does not reach ditches and hollows are filled, and where words and thought do not reach sky is wide and earth is wide, striking his staff, the oil-seller laughs, the busy busy and the idle idle.
